小日本.definition:
1. a form of insult against Japanese people mostly due to the various atrocities committed in WWII. This, along with a few others, form of insult [generally] sprang up when Japan tries to downplay its role in WWII.

2. a [personification] of the phrase under the name as an attempt to downplay/weaken the aforementioned insult as a way to saturate [Google image] with said character. While 小日本 is not as popular as the more well known 日本鬼子
小日本.example: 小日本 [literally] means little/puny [Japanese] ([something to do] with their average height back in WWII era)
